name: listPrepend
description: Inserts an element at the beginning of a list.
syntax: listPrepend( string list, string value, [string delimiters], [boolean includeEmptyFields] )

params.name: value
params.description: An element or a list of elements.

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if false it cleans up empty fields.
